carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible extending along the dorsal and upper-lateral surfaces toward the caudal peduncle, characterized by a sharp vertical transition from high-luminance upper edges to shaded lower recesses.

other_distinctive_markers: The caudal fin exhibits a high-contrast pattern of high-luminance circular spots and faint horizontal striations visible across the macro-mask of both the upper and lower lobes.
